# SHA-384 of every migration that has shipped, over the file's exact bytes.
# sqlx stores these in _sqlx_migrations and refuses to start when a shipped file
# no longer hashes to what an install already applied. Editing a migration that
# has shipped -- even reformatting it or changing its line endings -- therefore
# breaks every existing install, so this manifest pins them. Adding a migration
# means appending a line; a failing test on an existing line means revert the
# edit and write a new migration instead.
